inventory_scope: External values crossing Claude Code, GitHub Actions, npm/Bun, Git, Sentry, extension-provider, and filesystem boundaries consumed by the pm CLI and SDK.

boundaries.format: absolute workspace path encoded as a dash-prefixed directory slug
redacted workflow-run JSON payload with check name, conclusion, and head SHA
native path and file URL package specifications including spaces and percent encoding
redacted event JSON with issue id, timestamp, tags, and environment
argv forwarding and executable-path conventions across Bun releases
boundaries.waiver_reason: The matrix is exercised on hosted Bun runners; a single committed argv capture would falsely imply cross-version completeness.

boundaries.format: Win32 errno code, syscall, path, and message combinations
boundaries.waiver_reason: The existing windows-latest nightly is authoritative; private runner paths cannot be committed safely and need a redacted capture exporter first.

boundaries.format: Darwin errno code, syscall, path, and message combinations
boundaries.waiver_reason: The hosted macOS nightly is authoritative until the cross-platform redacted errno corpus exporter exists.

boundaries.format: provider-defined numeric or string-list measurement response
boundaries.waiver_reason: Providers are extension-owned and validated against their runtime contract; each provider package must own its captured service fixture.
